comparison.objective: Tighten and fit an already-threaded necktie on a collar form; candidate configures rigid industrial hardware.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated pulling and fitting of a reduced deformable tie model versus coaxial rigid-tool seating, wrench regrasping, and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Released five-second hold with knot size, collar gap, centering, blade orientation, and tip-length bounds; pulled-out or damaged fabric fails.
comparison.reason: Deformable material feed and garment fitting do not overlap meaningfully with threaded stop adjustment and functional cycle verification.
